Description: net_prefunding is the market ledger's signed prefunding. Live draws that cover a ledger hole add to it, and losses realized against the ledger subtract from it. A positive value is pool cash already paid ahead of a losing position's debt, so RFQ liquidation nets that debt against it instead of drawing again. It moves no funds and never limits a draw.

Whole quote coins reserved for this market's negative ledger, without a transfer or realized loss. Decimal integer text is exact during cached liquidation transitions; admitted reservations must fit max_draw.
